BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fish planting; amending RCW 77.18.060; andrepealing RCW 77.18.070.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.18.060 and 1999 c 363 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The fish and wildlife commission in consultation with thedepartment is authorized to determine which waters of the state areappropriate for this use ((during the 1999 and 2000 calendar years)).In making this determination, the commission shall seek geographicdistribution to assure opportunity to fishers statewide. The commission in consultation with the department will determinethe maximum number of fish that may be planted into state waters so asnot to compete with the wild populations of fish species in the waterbody.
RCW 77.18.070 (Program costs to be coveredby revenue increase) and 1999 c 363 s 3 are each repealed.
